Steward hot-fact honored: mapped the ATTESTED summon-harvest loop, not the folk-name 'Wraithlord skill' ambiguity; Wraithlord's Harbour ITEM enables the archetype -> item-defined-archetype law (SB low-life row): WITH-item form mapped as core.
